ults and children 12 years of age and older: 2 teaspoonfuls (10 mL) every 4 to 6 hours. Children 6 to under 12 years of age: 1 teaspoonful (5 mL) every 4 to 6 hours. Children under 6 years of age: Consult a physician. Not to exceed 4 doses in 24 hours.
